title: Morning Check-In
description:
Morning wellness check-in for the {family_name} family.

1. Read families/{family_id}/family.md — load Current section
2. Identify who is currently with {care_recipient} (check Care Team + This Week schedule)
3. Message that person: 'Good morning {caregiver}. How did {care_recipient} sleep last night? Any concerns this morning?'
4. Wait for response. Log in Recent Updates.
5. If concerning (poor sleep, pain, confusion): add to Urgent Notes, notify primary caregiver
6. Remind of today's schedule from This Week section
7. If medications are due in the morning: trigger medication reminder if not already scheduled
